LESSON: CONSTRUCTING FRAMED SUSPENDED GARDEN

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.2: Constructing Framed Suspended Garden

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Constructing Framed Suspended Garden. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Constructing Framed Suspended Garden
2. Practise Constructing Framed Suspended Garden at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Constructing Framed Suspended Garden

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Constructing Framed Suspended Garden
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Constructing Framed Suspended Garden. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Constructing Framed Suspended Garden at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Constructing Framed Suspended Garden at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Constructing Framed Suspended Garden
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Constructing Framed Suspended Garden. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Constructing Framed Suspended Garden using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Constructing Framed Suspended Garden in the examples.
2. Explain Constructing Framed Suspended Garden to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Constructing Framed Suspended Garden.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Constructing Framed Suspended Garden using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Constructing Framed Suspended Garden important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Constructing Framed Suspended Garden
2. Practise Constructing Framed Suspended Garden at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Constructing Framed Suspended Garden

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
